Glowing_Ruby_Optic_Lenses.description: Embedded within the crystalline cephalon, these Glowing_Ruby_Optic_Lenses pulse with arcane energy, enhancing the construct's perception and accuracy while granting it the ability to see in darkness and emit radiant light.

Clockwork_Aperture_Irises.description: The Clockwork Aperture Irises are intricate mechanical eyes, crafted with gears and lenses that grant unparalleled precision and clarity, enhancing perception and accuracy while bestowing the wielder with the skills Target Lock and True Strike.

Blank_Porcelain_Doll_Eyes.description: These cold, unblinking eyes crafted from flawless porcelain seem to gaze into the depths of the soul, their unnatural beauty and eerie stillness granting a chilling allure that can both captivate and terrify those who meet its gaze, enhancing charm and instilling dread.

Hollow_Obsidian_Gargoyle_Sockets.description: Embedded within the stony visage of the gargoyle, these hollow obsidian sockets are more than mere eyes; they are conduits to the dark arcane, granting the construct an unsettling keenness of sight and the ability to move unseen in the shadows.

Steam_Hissing_Goggle_Lenses.description: These goggle lenses, forged from intricate steam-powered mechanisms, enhance the wearer's perception by two, allowing them to see through the haze of battle, but their mechanical hum and the constant hiss of steam reduce their charisma by one, making social interactions less fluid.

Necrotic_Soul_Fire_Eyes.description: Enveloped in an eerie, flickering flame, these eyes are the haunting gaze of a necromantic construct, their wisdom steeped in the dark arts yet their charisma drained by the soul-sapping essence of the undead, casting an aura of fiery dread upon all who meet their gaze.

Cybernetic_Targeting_Sensors.description: Embedded within the cranium, these cold, mechanical eyes flicker with an intelligence of their own, enhancing the construct's innate accuracy and perception, granting it the ability to lock onto targets with unnerving precision and deliver true strikes that bypass even the most fortified defenses.

Polished_Mithril_Mirror_Eyes.description: The Polished Mithril Mirror Eyes are a mesmerizing construct of gleaming metal, embedded within the cephalon of a dark sorcerer, reflecting the world in a cold, calculating manner. These eyes grant the user a heightened wisdom and charisma, while casting a faint, protective glow and the uncanny ability to deflect harmful spells back upon their caster.

Scrap_Glass_Shattered_Lenses.description: Fragments of reflective glass, etched with arcane symbols, form these shattered lenses, granting the wearer heightened perception as they gaze upon the world through a distorted, yet magically potent, view, though their unsettling appearance and the eerie glint of the shards instill fear and mistrust in those around them.

Living_Wood_Amber_Sap_Eyes.description: Embedded deep within the gnarled, sentient wood of ancient forests, these eyes are crafted from molten amber, granting an eerie, unblinking gaze that pierces through the veil of darkness, imbued with an ancient wisdom and heightened perception that rivals the oldest trees of the realm.
